assumptions: The primary target operating system is Windows, as the developer is using Windows.
The application will have a Graphical User Interface (GUI) rather than being just a command-line tool.
The software is intended for personal desktop computers rather than server environments.
The initial release will target individual consumer users looking for a simple, fast cleanup utility.
candidates: File scanner for standard cache, temporary files, and log files.
Visual disk analyzer (e.g. Treemap/Sunburst chart) for large files and folders.
confirmed: The core purpose of the software is to scan and clean up disk space on a computer (磁盘清理/空间释放).
conflicts: Automated One-Click Cleanup vs. Granular Control: General users prefer a single button that 'just works' safely, while advanced users demand to see and approve every file before deletion.
Deep/Thorough Scan vs. Speed: Scanning deep directories or calculating file hashes (for duplicates) takes significant time, conflicting with the expectation of a lightweight and fast utility.
